title: Which BLACKPINK Vibe Matches Your Personality?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover which BLACKPINK vibe matches yours!

questions.text: How do you prefer to enjoy BLACKPINK's music?

options.text: Blast it with friends and sing along loudly
Listen alone with headphones, savoring every lyric
Focus on the beat and choreography details
Imagine the story or message behind the song

questions.text: When planning a group hangout to watch a BLACKPINK concert

options.text: Check what everyone else is in the mood for first
Pick the most convenient time and place for everyone
Create a detailed schedule with snacks and seating
Go with the flow and decide when everyone arrives

questions.text: You hear about a new BLACKPINK dance challenge online. You...

options.text: Gather friends to learn and film it together
Practice alone until you nail every move
Follow step-by-step tutorials to get it right
Add your own twists to make it unique

questions.text: After a long day, you unwind by...

options.text: Calling a friend to chat about your day
Listing tasks to tackle tomorrow to feel in control
Sticking to your usual routine like reading or stretching
Doing something random, like baking or exploring a new park

questions.text: Choosing an outfit for a BLACKPINK-themed party, you go for...

options.text: Something bold and eye-catching to stand out
Comfortable and simple, not too flashy
Practical pieces that let you dance and move easily
Unique accessories or colors that reflect your style

questions.text: A friend disagrees with your favorite BLACKPINK song. You...

options.text: Ask why they feel that way to understand their perspective
Explain the song's lyrics and production to back your choice
Suggest a compromise by listening to both songs
Laugh it off and change the subject to avoid conflict
Going to a fan meetup or K-pop event with a group
Staying home to rewatch BLACKPINK interviews
Trying a new café that plays K-pop music
Planning a future trip to Seoul to see BLACKPINK live

questions.text: Learning a new skill, like playing a BLACKPINK song on guitar, you...

options.text: Ask a friend to learn with you for motivation
Focus on the most efficient techniques to progress fast
Set a daily practice time and track your progress
Play around with chords and see what sounds good

questions.text: A friend gives you a BLACKPINK merch as a surprise gift. You...

options.text: Hug them and gush about how much you love it
Thank them softly but genuinely, smiling warmly
Notice the quality and how you'll use it daily
Appreciate the thought and what it says about your friendship

questions.text: In a team project about BLACKPINK's impact, you take charge of...

options.text: Leading group discussions and keeping everyone engaged
Researching data and facts quietly on your own
Organizing tasks and making sure deadlines are met
Brainstorming creative angles to present the topic

questions.text: When feeling stressed about a big event, you...

options.text: Talk to someone about your worries to feel better
Break down the problem into small steps to solve it
Stick to your pre-planned routine to stay calm
Take a short walk or listen to music to clear your head

questions.text: Choosing a BLACKPINK song to cover, you pick...

options.text: A popular hit that everyone will sing along to
A deep cut with lyrics that resonate personally
One with a catchy melody that's easy to learn
A song with complex emotions or storytelling

results.title: The Sparkling Performer
results.description: You thrive in the spotlight, just like BLACKPINK’s dynamic stage presence. Energetic and outgoing, you light up any room with your enthusiasm. You love connecting with others, whether through music, dance, or laughter, and your spontaneous spirit makes every moment feel exciting. You’re an ESFP—vibrant, playful, and always ready to shine.

results.title: The Quiet Dreamer
results.description: You’re introspective and deeply in touch with your emotions, much like the soulful side of BLACKPINK’s music. You value meaning and authenticity, often lost in thought or daydreams. You care deeply about others but prefer quiet moments of connection over large crowds. You’re an INFP—idealistic, creative, and guided by your heart.

results.title: The Practical Leader
results.description: You’re organized, reliable, and take charge when needed, mirroring BLACKPINK’s disciplined work ethic. You focus on facts and efficiency, ensuring tasks get done right and on time. Others look to you for guidance, and you thrive in structured environments. You’re an ESTJ—decisive, responsible, and a natural leader.

results.title: The Creative Visionary
results.description: You see possibilities others miss, like BLACKPINK’s innovative concepts and bold artistry. Curious and quick-witted, you love brainstorming ideas and challenging the status quo. You’re always thinking ahead, turning abstract thoughts into exciting plans. You’re an ENTP—clever, adaptable, and a born innovator.

results.title: The Nurturing Guardian
results.description: You’re the heart of your group, offering support and care like BLACKPINK’s bond with their fans. You notice small details about others’ needs and go out of your way to help. Reliable and compassionate, you create a sense of warmth wherever you go. You’re an ISFJ—loyal, generous, and dedicated to others.

results.title: The Strategic Architect
results.description: You’re a big-picture thinker with a plan, much like BLACKPINK’s calculated rise to global stardom. Logical and independent, you thrive on solving complex problems and setting long-term goals. You’re confident in your ideas and work tirelessly to turn them into reality. You’re an INTJ—visionary, analytical, and determined.

results.title: The Charismatic Mentor
results.description: You inspire others with your warmth and vision, like BLACKPINK empowering their fans. You’re natural at bringing people together, encouraging growth, and making everyone feel valued. You blend empathy with leadership, creating a positive impact wherever you go. You’re an ENFJ—charismatic, supportive, and a catalyst for change.

results.title: The Adaptable Craftsman
results.description: You’re hands-on and quick to adapt, much like BLACKPINK’s ability to master diverse genres. You prefer action over words, solving problems with practical skills and a calm demeanor. You enjoy learning through experience and thrive in dynamic, unplanned situations. You’re an ISTP—resourceful, cool-headed, and a natural problem-solver.

results.title: The Bold Risk-Taker
results.description: You live for excitement and new challenges, mirroring BLACKPINK’s fearless approach to their craft. Spontaneous and confident, you’re always up for trying something new, whether it’s a dance trend or a bold fashion choice. You thrive in the moment and turn every experience into an adventure. You’re an ESTP—energetic, bold, and ready for anything.

results.title: The Analytical Thinker
results.description: You love diving into ideas and understanding how things work, like dissecting BLACKPINK’s music production. Curious and logical, you enjoy debating concepts and exploring new theories. You prefer deep conversations over small talk and value knowledge above all. You’re an INTP—intellectual, innovative, and a lifelong learner.

results.title: The Reliable Organizer
results.description: You’re the backbone of any team, with a knack for structure and precision, much like BLACKPINK’s polished performances. You take pride in being dependable, following through on promises, and keeping things in order. You value tradition and stability, making others feel secure. You’re an ISTJ—responsible, detail-oriented, and trustworthy.

results.title: The Artistic Sensitive
results.description: You see beauty in the world around you, like BLACKPINK’s visually stunning music videos. Creative and in touch with your senses, you express yourself through art, music, or style. You value authenticity and find joy in simple, meaningful moments. You’re an ISFP—artistic, gentle, and deeply in tune with your surroundings.

results.title: The Warm Harmonizer
results.description: You excel at bringing people together, creating harmony like BLACKPINK’s group chemistry. Friendly and approachable, you go out of your way to make others feel included. You’re the glue that holds your circle together, always ready to lend a listening ear. You’re an ESFJ—sociable, caring, and a natural peacemaker.

results.title: The Enthusiastic Idealist
results.description: You’re充满激情和乐观，就像BLACKPINK传递的正能量。你对新想法充满好奇，总是看到可能性，并用热情感染周围的人。你热爱探索和分享，让平凡的日子变得充满意义。你是ENFP——富有想象力、热情洋溢，是梦想的追求者。

results.title: The Decisive Commander
results.description: You’re a natural leader with a clear vision, much like BLACKPINK’s bold artistic direction. Confident and strategic, you make tough decisions with ease and inspire others to follow. You’re driven by goals and thrive on achieving success. You’re an ENTJ—assertive, visionary, and a force to be reckoned with.

results.title: The Insightful Counselor
results.description: You have a deep understanding of people and their emotions, like BLACKPINK’s ability to connect with fans on a personal level. Intuitive and compassionate, you offer wise advice and create a safe space for others to open up. You’re guided by empathy and a desire to help others grow. You’re an INFJ—insightful, caring, and a quiet force of good.
